_doc: Tutorials: shown once, step by step, the first time the player opens each part of the game (views/Tutorial.ts). 'target' names a part of that screen that gets a red frame (the rest is dimmed); no target = a centered note. The Tutorials window (main menu / pause menu) lists them all.

steps.title: Welcome!
steps.text: Between battles you grow your castle here: buildings make resources and the Research Lab makes the towers stronger. Then you go outside and hold the wall against the next wave.

steps.title: Resources
steps.text: Food, material and gold pay for buildings, towers and research. Energy Cores (blue) come from the Base and from bosses. The current wave and phase are on the right.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Build Farms (food), Workshops (material) and the Research Lab. Tap a building to upgrade or move it. The Base opens the heroes and the Market, the Lab opens the research tree.

steps.title: The Base
steps.text: Centers the view on your Base. The Base level sets the highest level of the other buildings and towers, and how many of them you can build.

steps.title: Guide
steps.text: What to do next. A red dot on it means something useful can be done right now (and the Enemy armor you need for the next wave is there too).

steps.title: Go Outside
steps.text: The battlefield: build towers left of the wall and start the next wave.

steps.title: Menu
steps.text: Save, load, settings and these tutorials.

steps.title: Defense area
steps.text: Towers are built in this area, left of the wall. Tap a tower to upgrade or move it, change its target mode or read its effects.

steps.title: Build Tower
steps.text: Crossbow: fast, one target. Crystal: magic. Catapult: area damage, cannot hit flying enemies. Halo Spire (research): buffs the towers around it, raises a shield against projectiles and mends the wall.

steps.title: The wall
steps.text: Enemies that reach the wall damage it; at 0 HP the game is over. Repair it here between waves (Halo Spires with Mending Halo also heal it).

steps.title: Enemy armor
steps.text: Enemy defense grows with the waves: keep Armor / Spell Piercing up to the needed value. Later waves also resist effects and take less damage from towers, but never from hero skills.

steps.title: Next wave
steps.text: How many enemies are coming. Every 10th wave brings a boss.

steps.title: Start Wave
steps.text: Starts the battle. Towers fire on their own; you can cast hero skills during the wave.

steps.title: Back to the castle
steps.text: Spend what you earned between waves.

steps.title: Hero skills
steps.text: Tap a hero card, then the spot (some skills hit the whole field). A skill can be used once every few waves. Skills deal true damage: they ignore every defense and damage reduction. Keep some for the boss waves!

steps.title: Game speed
steps.text: Speed the battle up (x1 to x10).

steps.title: Pause
steps.text: Pauses the battle.

steps.title: Recruit
steps.text: Recruit a random hero (3 to 5 stars). Every hero you own makes the next one a bit more expensive.

steps.title: Your heroes
steps.text: Their buffs help every tower and your economy. Tap a card to see a hero, teach it a skill or promote it.

steps.title: Not recruited yet
steps.text: The heroes you can still get.

steps.title: The card
steps.text: Stars: one random buff per star. Promoted heroes show their new stars on top of the card.

steps.title: Buffs and skills
steps.text: The hero's buffs and the skills it learned. Passive skills work all the time and some combine very well with each other: choose them with care.

steps.title: Learn a skill
steps.text: Uses a skill book (bought at the Market) and 1 Energy Core. 5-star heroes learn 1 active + 1 passive skill, the others 1 skill of any kind.

steps.title: Promote
steps.text: Straight to 5 stars (research Ascension first): more buffs and a second skill slot.

steps.title: Trade
steps.text: Pick what you give and what you get, then the amount. Use it when one resource blocks you while the others pile up.

steps.title: Rate
steps.text: How much you get for what you give.

steps.title: Trade
steps.text: Confirms the trade.

steps.title: Skill Books
steps.text: Hero skill books are sold here.

steps.title: Book shop
steps.text: A new choice of books every wave; prices grow with the waves. Effect passives are sold once their tower effect is unlocked.

steps.title: Your books
steps.text: Teach them to your heroes from the hero window (Base > Heroes > tap a card).

steps.title: The research tree
steps.text: Tap a node to see what it does and research it. A node needs its parent at max level; tiers 2 and 3 open with the Research Lab level.

steps.title: Branches
steps.text: Jump to a branch: offense, economy, fortification, tower effects, heroes, curses.

steps.title: Research Lab
steps.text: What your Lab level allows. Upgrade the Lab in the castle to open more.

steps.title: Zoom
steps.text: Zoom in and out (you can also drag the tree).

_doc_guide: Guide (views/Guide.ts, castle button at the bottom right): the goals of a game by stage. A stage lasts until its 'until' wave (0 = every wave, null = after the last stage). 'priority' 1-5 is shown as stars (5 = do it first). Goal ids: armor, wall, base, farms, workshops, lab, buildings, towers, towerLevel, scholarship, research (target = technologies at max level), researchAll, smart, heroes (target), skills (perHero 1, or 'full' = every slot), halo, awaken, masteries, treeRest, promote, endless (tech, target level). Unfinished goals of a past stage move to the current one (marked late).

stages.title: Hold as long as you can
